name: Kobold Barbarian 13
body:
Note: This NPC was originally presented as a 12th level kobold barbarian. To preserve the intended challenge rating, she has been redone as a 13th level barbarian.

Kobold Barbarian 13
CR 12

XP 19,200
Female Kobold barbarian 13
CE Small Humanoid (Reptilian)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 12, flat-footed 19 (+7 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural, -2 rage, +2 shield, +1 size)
hp 161 (13d12+12 favored class+39 rage +26)
Fort +16, Ref +7, Will +10; +4 vs. Traps, +5 vs. spells, supernatural and spell-like abilities
Defensive Abilities Improved Uncanny Dodge, Rage Powers (superstition +5, increased DR 2/-), Trap Sense +4; DR 5/-
Weaknesses Light Sensitivity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +3 short spear +23/+18/+13 (1d4+8)
Special Attacks Greater Rage (30 rounds), Rage Powers (mighty swing, no escape, power blow)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +13; CMB +17; CMD 30
Feats Blind-Fight, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lunge, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (short spear)
Skills Craft (trapmaking) +17, Perception +18, Stealth +14, Survival +16, Swim +7; Racial Modifiers +2 Craft (trapmaking), +2 Perception, +2 Profession (miner)
Languages Common, Draconic
Combat Gear necklace of fireballs (type IV); Other Gear +1 breastplate, +1 buckler, +3 shortspear, 11gp, 12 sp, 12 cp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Unraged Statistics (n/a)

AC 24, touch 14, flat-footed 21;
hp 122;
Fort +13, Will +7; DR 3/-;
Melee +3 short spear +20/+15/+10 (1d4+5);
Str 16, Con 14; CMB +14; CMD 27;
Skills Swim +4
